doctrine.model: AI-powered B2B local agency arbitrage. Human-facing relationship layer; 90% AI production backend. One operator running 4-7 person equivalent output. Not a photography studio — a media production system disguised as one.

icp.primary: Criminal defense attorneys (75-100 manually sourced leads, verified visual gaps: outdated photos, mismatched team pages, weak Avvo/LinkedIn presence, Google Ads active but visual assets poor).
icp.secondary: Law firms, med spas, fitness centers, data centers.
verification_signals: Google Ads visibility with weak creative
5+ years experience with no updated brand visuals

pricing_and_margin.team_session: $1,500 per session, ~94% margin (~$1,411 profit per booking)
pricing_and_margin.authority_book: $29-47 via Gumroad — trust signal and positioning tool, not primary revenue
pricing_and_margin.upsell: 48-hour gallery expiration upsell at $40/image — urgency-anchored, recovers margin on delivery

revenue_target.month_3_scoreboard: 60-80k LinkedIn impressions, 60-90 Instagram saves, 4-6 qualified B2B inquiries, $7-10k revenue
revenue_target.30_day_activation: 6-8 Mother's Day sessions (immediate), 500+ cold emails/week via Instantly, 3 Instagram posts/week, 6-hook parallel LinkedIn testing

revenue_levers: Channel partner pipeline: white-label to web agencies and PR firms
9-word reactivation cold email to 4,400+ warm leads

attorney_sequence.day_1: Visual Gap — identify the specific gap on their site/Avvo/LinkedIn
attorney_sequence.day_3: Competitor Angle — frame against a better-looking local competitor
attorney_sequence.day_7: Easy Close — lowest-friction call to book

cold_outreach.reactivation: 9-word cold email to warm list of 4,400+

attorney_positioning_angles: 2 AM tab comparison: prospects compare attorneys at night; losing to better-looking competitors is the frame
Premium retainer justification: visual authority removes sticker shock on high-fee engagements
Referral leakage plugging: warm referrals leave when the digital presence looks cheap

content_system.cultural_reserve: 20% reactive cultural hijack capacity — no consumer holidays, only earned cultural moments
content_system.instagram: 3 posts/week. Three-lane double-sided mirror: Archive / Today / Frame — serves photographers and B2B buyers simultaneously through operator-first copy
content_system.linkedin: 6-hook parallel testing. Credibility and conversion surface.
content_system.card_format: B2B authority content anchored to process and struggle, not polished perfection

psychological_foundation.buyer_psychology: High-ticket buyers ($800+) purchase authentic struggle and visible process — not polished perfection
psychological_foundation.rejection_as_moat: Side-hustle / off-camera operator framing is a trust signal, not a weakness — it signals no bloated agency overhead
psychological_foundation.operator_positioning: Off-camera operator identity = low overhead + AI leverage = credibility with practical buyers

production_rules: Trim final 10 frames of Kling AI video output — glitch artifacts accumulate there
Visual directive gate required before any booking — client must confirm visual direction before session is locked

feedback_loop.principle: Volume creates data, data creates clarity, clarity creates revenue
feedback_loop.photographer_community: Parallel validation loop — authority book and operator content build credibility inside creator community as proof layer

notes: Consolidated from 11 segments (seg 1-10 + seg 11). De-duplicated attorney ICP, cold email sequence, revenue levers, and positioning angles. No content dropped that carried unique operating value. Month 3 scoreboard and reactivation email moved from seg 11 into unified revenue section. Psychological foundation and production rules unified from seg 1-10 base.
